title: Three-line circuit shape
statement: For a natural number $n$, a three-line circuit shape specifies the operation of each of its three lines, four signed input literals supplying the first two lines, and the two operation types conjunction and disjunction available at each line. The third line combines the values of the first and second lines.
hypotheses_covered: Two signed input literals for the first line
